about: Revisions to an existing hunt. A Wowhead Forever scrape must not replace a lock. reportedBy is the Discord name. Henrik is the reporter when nobody else is named. Stats the client shows and Wowhead does not stay in client_item_overrides.json; check that file too.

272186.name: Overgrown Cuffs
272186.wowheadSays: Rot and Regret (93404) requires level 35. Maraudon is listed as level 42-52.
272186.kept: Required level 42, the level Maraudon can be entered. The chain is Word of the Woods (93594) from Mithera in Shen'dralas (53.2, 75.8), then Rot and Regret, which sends you into Maraudon. Same revision as Thornplated Cord.

272187.name: Thornplated Cord
272187.wowheadSays: Rot and Regret (93404) requires level 35. Maraudon is listed as level 42-52.
272187.kept: Required level 42. Same quest, chain, and pin as Overgrown Cuffs.

270080.name: Arathi Armbands
270080.wowheadSays: WANTED: Otto and Falconcrest (685) is Side: Alliance. The series box is empty.
270080.kept: Alliance only. The pin is the Wanted Board in Arathi Highlands (46.0, 47.7). Do not write quest chain 1: an empty series is not 'no prequests'. War Rider Bracers (4745) was already Alliance; this id had been left off that list.

1677.kept: Stranglethorn Vale. Mosh'Ogg Lord is not a Zul'Gurub mob.

12640.name: Lionheart Helm
12640.wowheadSays: Plans: Lionheart Helm (12717) is not an LBRS boss. The Forever drops that are not Classic Era leftovers are Ferra in Dire Maul (2 of 80), then rare Blackrock Spire trash and a Plague Ghoul in Stratholme.
12640.kept: Boss drop. The plans drop from Ferra. The pin is the Dire Maul entrance in Feralas. Do not file it as a trainer recipe or as a Lower Blackrock Spire boss.

6898.wowheadSays: The quest is both factions. It starts with Doan Karhan in the Barrens.
6898.kept: Both factions. The pin is Doan Karhan. Alliance still sees it. The Barrens is not a reason to hide a both-faction quest.

279878.name: Apprentice Sorcerer's Slacks
279878.wowheadSays: The Web of Magic series box is empty.
279878.kept: Alliance. The chain is The Second Rebellion, Bad Medicine, Kurzen's Mystery, Troll Witchery, An Acquaintance in Southshore, Magics of the Drowned City, then The Web of Magic. The pin is Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale. Do not write the chain back to 1.

285190.name: Wyvern Heart Band
285190.wowheadSays: Dropped by Heartrazor. The Forever tooltip is Level 32 Beast (Rare Elite) in Thousand Needles. The listview source is a drop, which had been stored as a world drop.
285190.kept: Rare NPC. Heartrazor in Thousand Needles. The hunt line stays Drops from Heartrazor.

287000.name: Skin-Flayed Footguards
287000.wowheadSays: Drop in The Drowned City. The tooltip names no creature. The row was Unsourced.
287000.kept: Dungeon trash in The Drowned City. No named mob, so the line is Drops from trash in The Drowned City.

274602.name: Brinebelly Leggings
274602.wowheadSays: Dropped by Var'Taka in The Drowned City. The tooltip says Humanoid (Elite) and does not say Boss. The row was a world drop.
274602.kept: Boss drop. Var'Taka in The Drowned City. A missing boss flag is not trash. The hunt line stays Drops from Var'Taka.

271804.name: Soulsplatter Mace
271804.wowheadSays: Khan Jehn (93196) is the Magram ritual. The stored chain listed Brutal Politics and then Magram Alliance. Those two quests are the same step: Friendly with the Magram, then speak with Warug. Brutal Politics is Alliance. Magram Alliance is Horde.
271804.kept: Both factions keep the mace. Alliance chain starts at Brutal Politics and skips Magram Alliance. Horde chain starts at Magram Alliance and skips Brutal Politics. Both continue at Broken Tears through Khan Jehn. The same split is on the other Magram rewards (271796, 271797, 271798, 271800, 271803). The Gelkis rewards skip the other faction's starter the same way: Alliance Strange Alliance, Horde Gelkis Alliance.

281636.name: Museum Keeper's Chain
281636.wowheadSays: Greater Friend of the Library (84394) has no Requires Level. The tooltip has no Requires Level line. The page comment is 50. Stored required level was 53, the item-level floor for item level 58.
281636.kept: Required level 50. Rango wears it at 50. Artifact Seeker's Pendant (277202) and Antique Bulwark (281637) are the same reward and stay at 50.

277202.name: Artifact Seeker's Pendant
277202.wowheadSays: Same quest as Museum Keeper's Chain. No Requires Level line. Stored required level was 53.
277202.kept: Required level 50, with the other two rewards from Greater Friend of the Library (84394).
